data.title: 妮芙 · 面包店的小纸袋
data.description: 店员把刚烤好的面包装进纸袋。她双手接过来，小心避开还烫手的袋底，准备带回去和大家分享。
data.action: 单手提着刚烘焙出炉的牛皮纸面包袋，萨卡兹小角在阳光下微泛光芒
data.camera: 中景，纸袋与面包柜可见
data.promptProse: Outside a quaint bakery on a sunny corner, Sarkaz girl Nymph excitedly hugs a crinkling paper bag of warm pastries to her chest, her pink hair catching the bright morning rays. The shop's colorful striped awning flutters overhead, while sidewalk flower pots and window displays of tiered cakes create a cheerful street scene.
